Era.note: This is the raid-dropped sword itself. The 'purified' legendary upgrade needs content beyond the original 1-60 game, so under classic rules this goal is really about the Corrupted Ashbringer drop.
tips: You'll need a 40-player raid that clears Naxxramas every week.
Attunement needs Honored with the {rep_argentdawn:Argent Dawn} and a {item:12811:Righteous Orb}: 5 {item:12363:Arcane Crystals} and 2 {item:20725:Nexus Crystals} at Honored, fewer at Revered.
The chest appears after the Four Horsemen die. Keep clearing weekly until the sword drops.
The Four Horsemen are Highlord Mograine, Thane Korth'azz, Sir Zeliek and Baron Rivendare. Raids use either a 2-tank rotation or a synced 4-group kill.
The drop chance is very low, and the sword is Bind on Pickup, so only one raider can get it per kill.
Unequip it before visiting Argent Dawn NPCs. Wielding it makes them hostile.

steps.text: Get {att_naxx:attuned to Naxxramas} from Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel.
Clear the Military Wing of {raid_naxx:Naxxramas} up to the Four Horsemen.
Loot Corrupted Ashbringer from the Four Horsemen Chest.

Era.name: Corrupted Ashbringer

Era.note: Alliance-only mount, ~900g at Exalted. Non-Night Elves also need Darnassus Exalted to learn Tiger Riding.
tips: Level 60 makes the trip and the daily kills much safer.
'Frostsaber Provisions' takes 5 {item:12622:Shardtooth Meat} (Shardtooth bears) and 5 {item:12623:Chillwind Meat} (Chillwind chimaeras), both in Winterspring.
'Winterfall Intrusion' asks for 5 Winterfall Shaman and 5 Winterfall Ursa at Winterfall Village; the 'Rampaging Giants' are near Frostsaber Rock.
Exalted is the long part: expect several weeks even doing every turn-in daily.
Era.name: Winterspring Frostsaber

steps.text: Reach level 40 and travel to Winterspring.
Start Rivern Frostwind's quests at Frostsaber Rock in Winterspring.
Turn in 'Frostsaber Provisions' daily until 1500/3000 Neutral.
Turn in 'Winterfall Intrusion' daily until Friendly.
Reach Honored, then add 'Rampaging Giants' to your dailies.
Reach Exalted with the Wintersaber Trainers.
Reach Exalted with Darnassus to learn Frostsaber riding (Night Elves skip this).
Buy the Reins of the Winterspring Frostsaber from Rivern Frostwind (about 900 gold).

Era.note: Only for Druid, Mage, Priest, or Warlock. Requires access to Naxxramas, Ahn'Qiraj 40, and Stratholme.
tips: Each class (Druid, Mage, Priest, Warlock) gets its own short purification questline and its own version of the staff.
Atiesh gives a raid-wide aura, so guilds often hand the splinters to a support player.
Era.name: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian

steps.text: Raid {raid_naxx:Naxxramas} and {raid_aq40:Ahn'Qiraj} on a Druid, Mage, Priest or Warlock.
Collect 40 Splinters of Atiesh from Naxxramas bosses.
Combine the 40 splinters into the Frame of Atiesh.
Bring the Frame of Atiesh to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.
Loot the Staff Head of Atiesh from Kel'Thuzad in Naxxramas.
Loot the Base of Atiesh from C'Thun in Ahn'Qiraj.

steps: Complete your class's purification quest from Anachronos.
Defeat the guardian the staff summons on Festival Lane in Stratholme.

steps.text: Receive Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian from Anachronos.

Era.note: Hunter-only epic bow. It's built from the Ancient Rune Etched Stave you earn in the Lok'delar chain, so do that goal first. Since patch 1.8 one Hunter ends up with both weapons.
tips: Optional: kill Azuregos in Azshara for a {item:18704:Mature Blue Dragon Sinew}, then turn in 'Ancient Sinew Wrapped Lamina' for the matching epic quiver.
Era.name: Rhok'delar, Longbow of the Ancient Keepers

steps.text: Get the Ancient Rune Etched Stave from 'Stave of the Ancients' (the {lokdelar:Lok'delar} goal).
Pick up 'A Proper String' from Stoma the Ancient in Felwood.
Loot the Mature Black Dragon Sinew from {raid_ony:Onyxia}.
Turn in the sinew to Vartrus for the Enchanted Black Dragon Sinew.
Combine the stave and the Enchanted Black Dragon Sinew into Rhok'delar.

Era.note: Hunter-only epic staff, the first half of the Ancient Keepers chain. The same turn-in also gives the Ancient Rune Etched Stave used to make Rhok'delar.
tips: Fight each demon alone. If another player helps, the fight is forfeit.
Keep the {item:18707:Ancient Rune Etched Stave}: it becomes {item:18713:Rhok'delar}.
Era.name: Lok'delar, Stave of the Ancient Keepers

steps.text: Loot the Ancient Petrified Leaf from the Cache of the Firelord in {raid_mc:Molten Core}.
Bring the leaf to Vartrus the Ancient in Felwood and pick up 'Stave of the Ancients'.
Solo Artorius the Doombringer in Winterspring.
Solo Klinfran the Crazed in Burning Steppes.
Solo Solenor the Slayer in Silithus.
Solo Simone the Seductress in Un'Goro Crater.
Turn in the four demon heads to Vartrus for Lok'delar and the Ancient Rune Etched Stave.

Era.note: The classic legendary. Both bindings are roughly a 3% drop each, so this is usually a long farm even with consistent weekly clears.
tips: Each half of the {item:18563:Bindings of the Windseeker} is a rare drop, roughly 3%, so plan on many weekly Molten Core clears.
You need one binding in hand to start 'Examine the Vessel'.
Era.name: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker

steps.text: Raid {raid_mc:Molten Core} on a weekly reset schedule.
Loot the Bindings of the Windseeker (left) from Baron Geddon in Molten Core.
Loot the Bindings of the Windseeker (right) from Garr in Molten Core.
Start 'Examine the Vessel' with Highlord Demitrian in Silithus.
Loot the Essence of the Firelord from Ragnaros in Molten Core.
Turn in the bindings, the Essence and the materials to Demitrian ('Thunderaan the Windseeker').
Turn in 'Rise, Thunderfury!' to receive Thunderfury.

tips: You need to be {att_naxx:attuned to Naxxramas} (Honored with the {rep_argentdawn:Argent Dawn}, plus a {item:12811:Righteous Orb}) on each character that raids it.

Quartermasters at Light's Hope Chapel: Korfax, Champion of the Light (Warrior), Commander Eligor Dawnbringer (Paladin), Huntsman Leopold (Hunter), Rohan the Assassin (Rogue), Father Inigo Montoy (Priest), Rayne (Druid), Archmage Angela Dosantos (Mage), Mataus the Wrathcaster (Warlock), Rimblat Earthshatter (Shaman).
Wartorn scraps drop from trash all over Naxxramas. Each armor type has its own scrap (cloth, leather, chain or plate).
A piece ticks itself when you own it, along with its materials. Tick materials by hand as you collect them.
Era.name: Tier 3 Set Appearances

Era.note: Priest-only. One staff with two forms: Benediction (Holy) and Anathema (Shadow).
tips: The peasant event runs 5+ minutes. If it fails, Eris resets after about 15 minutes.
Right-click the finished staff to swap between {item:18608:Benediction} (Holy) and {item:18609:Anathema} (Shadow). Swapping has a 30-minute cooldown.
Era.name: Benediction / Anathema

steps.text: Loot The Eye of Divinity from Majordomo Executus in {raid_mc:Molten Core}.
Start 'The Balance of Light and Shadow' with Eris Havenfire near Stratholme.
Save 50 peasants (fewer than 15 deaths) to earn the Splinter of Nordrassil.
Loot The Eye of Shadow from demons in southern Winterspring, or buy one.
Combine the Splinter of Nordrassil, the Eye of Shadow and the Eye of Divinity into Benediction.

Era.note: The epic mount of each race in your faction: a level 60, swift riding trained, and gold. Any race can buy one at Exalted with its home city. Pick the mounts you want.

Train Expert Riding from your riding trainer
Save about 800-1,000 gold on that character

Reach Exalted with Orgrimmar (optional for Orcs)

tips: Your own race's mount needs no reputation. Another race's mount needs Exalted with that race's home city (Darkspear Trolls for the raptor, Ironforge for the ram).
Honored with the vendor's city gives a small discount.
Collecting them all on one character means Exalted with every city in your faction; the {rep_ambassador:Ambassador} goal covers that.
Each vendor sells a few colors of the same mount for the same price, and any of them counts.
Era.name: Epic Racial Mounts

Era.note: Two-handed legendary mace. You need the Eye of Sulfuras from Ragnaros and a Sulfuron Hammer crafted by a 300 Blacksmith (you or someone you trust). Combining them is instant, with no quest turn-in.
tips: The {item:17204:Eye of Sulfuras} is a rare drop from Ragnaros, roughly 3%.
'A Binding Contract' costs one {item:17203:Sulfuron Ingot} and needs no Thorium Brotherhood reputation. Lokhtos is in the Grim Guzzler.
Era.name: Sulfuras, Hand of Ragnaros

steps.text: Raid {raid_mc:Molten Core} on a weekly reset schedule.
Loot the Eye of Sulfuras from Ragnaros in Molten Core.
Get the Plans: Sulfuron Hammer from Lokhtos Darkbargainer in Blackrock Depths ('A Binding Contract').
Collect 8 Sulfuron Ingots from Golemagg the Incinerator in Molten Core.
Smelt 20 Dark Iron Bars at the Black Forge in Blackrock Depths.
Gather 10 Blood of the Mountain (rare from Dark Iron deposits).
Gather 10 Lava Cores (Molten Core trash, BoE).
Gather 10 Fiery Cores (Molten Core trash, BoE).
Reach 300 Blacksmithing, or find a Blacksmith to craft it.
Combine the Sulfuron Hammer and the Eye of Sulfuras into Sulfuras.

Era.name: Level Classes to 60
Era.note: Tracked automatically. Every character you log into is remembered, and each class shows its highest character's level, filling as you earn XP. A class completes when any character of it hits 60. Characters you haven't logged into since installing show as not seen yet.
The furbolgs of Felwood and Winterspring. Rewards include safe passage through the Timbermaw tunnels and leatherworking patterns.
tips: Kill Deadwood furbolgs in Felwood and Winterfall furbolgs in Winterspring for reputation.
Turn in {item:21377:Deadwood Headdress Feathers} and {item:21383:Winterfall Spirit Beads} in batches of 5 at Timbermaw Hold.
Era.name: Exalted: Timbermaw Hold

Era.note: Lokhtos Darkbargainer's epic crafting recipes unlock as you climb, including fire resistance gear.
tips: Turn in {item:11370:Dark Iron Ore} and {item:18942:Fiery Flux} to Lokhtos Darkbargainer (Grim Guzzler, Blackrock Depths) early on.
From Honored on, turn in Molten Core materials such as {item:17011:Lava Cores} and {item:17010:Fiery Cores}.
Era.name: Exalted: Thorium Brotherhood

Era.note: Honored opens the Naxxramas attunement; Exalted unlocks the best Argent Dawn shoulder enchants.
tips: Wear an {item:12846:Argent Dawn Commission} while killing undead in the Plaguelands, Stratholme and Scholomance.
Turn in Scourgestones at Light's Hope Chapel or Chillwind Camp.
Era.name: Exalted: Argent Dawn

Era.note: The druids of Silithus. Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj kills and Twilight cultist turn-ins carry most of the grind.
tips: Do the Silithus quests at Cenarion Hold.
Turn in {item:20404:Encrypted Twilight Texts} and run Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj for steady reputation.
Era.name: Exalted: Cenarion Circle

Era.note: Earned in Zul'Gurub. Unlocks the class-specific Zandalar armor sets and head/leg enchants.
tips: Clear Zul'Gurub; every kill in the raid gives Zandalar reputation.
Turn in sets of ZG coins and bijous at Yojamba Isle.
Era.name: Exalted: Zandalar Tribe

Era.note: Needed to douse Molten Core's runes without Aqual Quintessence; Revered gives the Eternal Quintessence.
tips: Speak with Duke Hydraxis on his island east of Azshara and do his quest chain.
Kill Molten Core trash and bosses; each kill adds reputation.
Era.name: Exalted: Hydraxian Waterlords

Era.note: Starts at Hated. The rings from Anachronos upgrade as you climb, and the grind is famously long.
tips: Complete 'The Charge of the Dragonflights' line to obtain your Signet Ring.
Clear Temple of Ahn'Qiraj; kills and {item:21230:Ancient Qiraji Artifacts} raise reputation.
Era.name: Exalted: Brood of Nozdormu

Era.note: Exalted with all four Alliance capitals. Your own race's city is the easy one; the rest take turn-ins.
tips: Each city has repeatable cloth turn-ins at its cloth quartermaster, the fastest route for most players.
Era.name: Ambassador: Alliance Capitals

Era.note: Exalted with all four Horde capitals. Your own race's city is the easy one; the rest take turn-ins.
tips: Each city has repeatable cloth turn-ins at its cloth quartermaster, the fastest route for most players.

steps.text: Reach Exalted with the Darkspear Trolls.

Era.name: Ambassador: Horde Capitals

Era.note: Baron Rivendare's own steed. A tiny drop chance in the undead side of Stratholme.
tips: Baron Rivendare is on Stratholme's undead side, through the service entrance, which the {key_strat:Key to the City} opens.
Run it with a group, or solo once you're well geared. The drop chance is tiny, so expect many runs.

steps.text: Loot Deathcharger's Reins from Baron Rivendare.

Era.name: Deathcharger's Reins

Era.note: Rare drop from Bloodlord Mandokir in Zul'Gurub.
tips: Zul'Gurub is a 20-player raid, so you'll need a raid group.

steps.text: Loot the Swift Razzashi Raptor from Bloodlord Mandokir.

Era.name: Swift Razzashi Raptor

Era.note: Rare drop from High Priest Thekal in Zul'Gurub.
tips: Zul'Gurub is a 20-player raid, so you'll need a raid group.

steps.text: Loot the Swift Zulian Tiger from High Priest Thekal.

Era.name: Swift Zulian Tiger

Era.note: The black battle tank, originally awarded only to Scarab Lords who rang the gong at the opening of Ahn'Qiraj. Whether Forever offers it again depends on how its gate event runs.
tips: The gong can only be rung once your realm's Ahn'Qiraj war effort is finished. Forever may run its own version of the event.
steps: Complete the Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain.
Ring the Scarab Gong in Silithus to open Ahn'Qiraj.

steps.text: Own the Black Qiraji Resonating Crystal.

Era.name: Black Qiraji Resonating Crystal

Era.note: The Warlock's epic mount, earned through a level 60 quest chain that ends with a summoning ritual in Dire Maul. Quest IDs checked on Wowhead.
tips: Warlock only, and the chain needs level 60.
The chain starts with a demon trainer: Spackle Thornberry (Stormwind) or Jubahl Corpseseeker (Ironforge) for the Alliance, Martha Strain (Undercity) or Kurgul (Orgrimmar) for the Horde.
The Dire Maul ritual is a group fight, so bring friends.

steps.text: Complete 'Mor'zul Bloodbringer' from a demon trainer in a capital city.
Defeat the Xorothian Dreadsteed in Dire Maul ('Dreadsteed of Xoroth').

Era.name: Dreadsteed (Warlock Epic Mount)

Era.note: The Paladin's epic mount, earned through Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker's level 60 quest chain that ends in Scholomance. Quest IDs checked on Wowhead.
tips: Paladin only, and the chain needs level 60.
Several steps ask for materials and gold, so read each quest's requirements before heading out.

steps.text: Complete 'Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker' from Duthorian Rall in Stormwind City.
Complete 'Judgment and Redemption' in {key_scholo:Scholomance} to earn the Charger.

Era.name: Charger (Paladin Epic Mount)

Era.note: Tanking sword (Warrior and Paladin) forged in Onyxia's breath.

steps.text: Loot Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying in Dire Maul (rare).
Get the Unfired Ancient Blade from 'The Forging of Quel'Serrar' in the Dire Maul library.
Heat the blade in {raid_ony:Onyxia's} fire breath.
Drive the Heated Ancient Blade into Onyxia's corpse before it cools.
Return the Treated Ancient Blade to receive Quel'Serrar.

Era.name: Quel'Serrar

Era.note: Boss kills tick off automatically when you're in the raid with the addon loaded.

steps.text: Complete {att_mc:Attunement to the Core} in Blackrock Depths.

Era.name: Clear Molten Core

Era.note: Needs the Drakefire Amulet from the faction-specific attunement chain.

steps.text: Earn the Drakefire Amulet from the {att_ony:Onyxia attunement}.
Loot the Head of Onyxia and turn it in at your capital city.

Era.name: Slay Onyxia

Era.note: Boss kills tick off automatically when you're in the raid with the addon loaded.

steps.text: Complete {att_bwl:Blackhand's Command} ({key_ubrs:Upper Blackrock Spire}) for attunement.

Era.name: Clear Blackwing Lair

Era.note: The 20-player troll raid. Gahz'ranka and the Edge of Madness boss are optional.
Era.name: Clear Zul'Gurub

Era.note: The 20-player AQ raid in Silithus. Kills here also build Cenarion Circle reputation.
tips: Moam, Buru and Ayamiss are optional; the raid can go straight from Rajaxx to Ossirian.
Ossirian is only vulnerable near the crystals around his room. Move him from crystal to crystal.
Era.name: Clear Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj

Era.note: The 40-player AQ raid. The Bug Trio, Viscidus and Ouro are optional for reaching C'Thun.
Era.name: Clear Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

Era.note: The hardest raid in the game: all four wings, Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad.

steps.text: Get {att_naxx:attuned to Naxxramas} at Light's Hope Chapel.

Era.name: Clear Naxxramas

Era.note: A new 20-player raid in Mount Hyjal, opening December 9, 2026. More bosses join this guide as they're revealed.

steps.text: Defeat The Wild King in Hyjal Summit.

Era.foreverNote: Its bosses, entrance and loot haven't been revealed yet; this guide grows as they are.
Era.name: Clear Hyjal Summit

Era.note: A new 10-player raid where the Night Elves hold dangerous prisoners, with three entrances, one in Mount Hyjal. Opens December 9, 2026.

steps.text: Defeat Sonya Darkhallow in the Barrow Deeps.

Era.foreverNote: Its bosses, entrances and loot haven't been revealed yet; this guide grows as they are.
Era.name: Clear the Barrow Deeps

Era.note: Required to enter Molten Core. A short trip into Blackrock Depths to the raid's entry portal.

steps.text: Pick up 'Attunement to the Core' from Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain.
Recover a Core Fragment at the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths.
Return the Core Fragment to Lothos Riftwaker.

Era.name: Attunement: Molten Core

Era.note: The Alliance chain to the Drakefire Amulet, which opens Onyxia's Lair. It runs through Blackrock Spire and Blackrock Depths and ends with a masquerade in Stormwind.

steps.text: Complete 'Dragonkin Menace' from Helendis Riverhorn in the Burning Steppes.
Complete 'Drakefire Amulet' and receive the amulet.

Era.name: Attunement: Onyxia's Lair (Alliance)

Era.note: The Horde chain to the Drakefire Amulet, which opens Onyxia's Lair. It runs through Blackrock Spire, the Test of Skulls and Upper Blackrock Spire.

steps.text: Complete 'Warlord's Command' and turn it in to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath, Badlands.
Complete 'Blood of the Black Dragon Champion' and receive the Drakefire Amulet.

Era.name: Attunement: Onyxia's Lair (Horde)

Era.note: Without the Mark of Drakkisath you can't use the orb into Blackwing Lair. The whole quest happens in Blackrock Spire.

steps.text: Loot and read Blackhand's Command from the Scarshield Quartermaster in Blackrock Spire.
Defeat General Drakkisath in {key_ubrs:Upper Blackrock Spire}.
Touch Drakkisath's Brand behind him to gain the Mark of Drakkisath.

Era.name: Attunement: Blackwing Lair

Era.note: Taken at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands once you're Honored with the Argent Dawn.
tips: Reaching Revered first makes the attunement cheaper.

steps.text: Get attuned at Light's Hope Chapel.

Era.name: Attunement: Naxxramas

Era.note: The Seal of Ascension opens Upper Blackrock Spire. You build it from gems collected in Lower Blackrock Spire.
Era.name: Key: Seal of Ascension (Upper Blackrock Spire)

Era.note: The Skeleton Key opens Scholomance's front door.

steps.text: Complete 'The Key to Scholomance' and receive the Skeleton Key.

Era.name: Key: Skeleton Key (Scholomance)

Era.note: Opens the Shadowforge doors inside Blackrock Depths.

steps.text: Complete the second 'Dark Iron Legacy' and receive the Shadowforge Key.

Era.name: Key: Shadowforge Key (Blackrock Depths)

Era.note: Opens the locked gates in Stratholme.

steps.text: Loot the Key to the City from Magistrate Barthilas.

Era.name: Key: Key to the City (Stratholme)

Era.note: Opens the locked doors in Dire Maul's West and North wings.

steps.text: Loot the Crescent Key from Pusillin in Dire Maul East.

Era.name: Key: Crescent Key (Dire Maul)

Era.note: Fishing, Cooking and First Aid to 300 on any character. Pick the ones you want in the Library; each ticks itself from your skill levels.
Era.name: Max Secondary Skills

Era.note: Primary professions at 300 somewhere on your roster. Pick the ones you care about in the Library; each ticks itself from your skill levels.
Era.name: Max Primary Professions

Era.note: Hold your gold target on a single character, with milestones on the way. Ticks itself from your gold.
Era.name: Save 5,000 Gold

Era.note: Find your people: join a guild and wear its colors. Ticks itself.
tips: Guilds recruit in the Guild Recruitment channel in capital cities, and in general chat.
{item:5976:Guild Tabards} are sold by the Guild Master in each capital city once your guild has designed its tabard.

steps.text: Buy a Guild Tabard from a Guild Master in a capital city.

Era.name: Join a Guild

Era.note: Add the people you enjoy playing with to your friends list. Ticks itself.
tips: Right-click a player's name and choose Add Friend, or type /friend and their name.

steps.text: Have 5 friends on your friends list.
Have 10 friends on your friends list.
Have 25 friends on your friends list.

target.step: Have %s friends on your friends list.

Era.name: Make Friends

Forever.note: This is the raid-dropped sword itself. The 'purified' legendary upgrade needs content beyond the original 1-60 game, so under classic rules this goal is really about the Corrupted Ashbringer drop.
tips: You'll need a 40-player raid that clears Naxxramas every week.
Attunement needs Honored with the {rep_argentdawn:Argent Dawn} and a {item:12811:Righteous Orb}: 5 {item:12363:Arcane Crystals} and 2 {item:20725:Nexus Crystals} at Honored, fewer at Revered.
The chest appears after the Four Horsemen die. Keep clearing weekly until the sword drops.
The Four Horsemen are Highlord Mograine, Thane Korth'azz, Sir Zeliek and Baron Rivendare. Raids use either a 2-tank rotation or a synced 4-group kill.
The drop chance is very low, and the sword is Bind on Pickup, so only one raider can get it per kill.
Unequip it before visiting Argent Dawn NPCs. Wielding it makes them hostile.

steps.text: Get {att_naxx:attuned to Naxxramas} from Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel.
Clear the Military Wing of {raid_naxx:Naxxramas} up to the Four Horsemen.
Loot Corrupted Ashbringer from the Four Horsemen Chest.

Forever.name: Corrupted Ashbringer

Forever.note: Alliance-only mount, ~900g at Exalted. Non-Night Elves also need Darnassus Exalted to learn Tiger Riding.
tips: Level 60 makes the trip and the daily kills much safer.
'Frostsaber Provisions' takes 5 {item:12622:Shardtooth Meat} (Shardtooth bears) and 5 {item:12623:Chillwind Meat} (Chillwind chimaeras), both in Winterspring.
'Winterfall Intrusion' asks for 5 Winterfall Shaman and 5 Winterfall Ursa at Winterfall Village; the 'Rampaging Giants' are near Frostsaber Rock.
Exalted is the long part: expect several weeks even doing every turn-in daily.
Forever.name: Winterspring Frostsaber

steps.text: Reach level 40 and travel to Winterspring.
Start Rivern Frostwind's quests at Frostsaber Rock in Winterspring.
Turn in 'Frostsaber Provisions' daily until 1500/3000 Neutral.
Turn in 'Winterfall Intrusion' daily until Friendly.
Reach Honored, then add 'Rampaging Giants' to your dailies.
Reach Exalted with the Wintersaber Trainers.
Reach Exalted with Darnassus to learn Frostsaber riding (Night Elves skip this).
Buy the Reins of the Winterspring Frostsaber from Rivern Frostwind (about 900 gold).

Forever.note: Only for Druid, Mage, Priest, or Warlock. Requires access to Naxxramas, Ahn'Qiraj 40, and Stratholme.
tips: Each class (Druid, Mage, Priest, Warlock) gets its own short purification questline and its own version of the staff.
Atiesh gives a raid-wide aura, so guilds often hand the splinters to a support player.
Forever.name: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian

steps.text: Raid {raid_naxx:Naxxramas} and {raid_aq40:Ahn'Qiraj} on a Druid, Mage, Priest or Warlock.
Collect 40 Splinters of Atiesh from Naxxramas bosses.
Combine the 40 splinters into the Frame of Atiesh.
Bring the Frame of Atiesh to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.
Loot the Staff Head of Atiesh from Kel'Thuzad in Naxxramas.
Loot the Base of Atiesh from C'Thun in Ahn'Qiraj.

steps: Complete your class's purification quest from Anachronos.
Defeat the guardian the staff summons on Festival Lane in Stratholme.

steps.text: Receive Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian from Anachronos.

Forever.note: Hunter-only epic bow. It's built from the Ancient Rune Etched Stave you earn in the Lok'delar chain, so do that goal first. Since patch 1.8 one Hunter ends up with both weapons.
tips: Optional: kill Azuregos in Azshara for a {item:18704:Mature Blue Dragon Sinew}, then turn in 'Ancient Sinew Wrapped Lamina' for the matching epic quiver.
Forever.name: Rhok'delar, Longbow of the Ancient Keepers

steps.text: Get the Ancient Rune Etched Stave from 'Stave of the Ancients' (the {lokdelar:Lok'delar} goal).
Pick up 'A Proper String' from Stoma the Ancient in Felwood.
Loot the Mature Black Dragon Sinew from {raid_ony:Onyxia}.
Turn in the sinew to Vartrus for the Enchanted Black Dragon Sinew.
Combine the stave and the Enchanted Black Dragon Sinew into Rhok'delar.

Forever.note: Hunter-only epic staff, the first half of the Ancient Keepers chain. The same turn-in also gives the Ancient Rune Etched Stave used to make Rhok'delar.
tips: Fight each demon alone. If another player helps, the fight is forfeit.
Keep the {item:18707:Ancient Rune Etched Stave}: it becomes {item:18713:Rhok'delar}.
Forever.name: Lok'delar, Stave of the Ancient Keepers

steps.text: Loot the Ancient Petrified Leaf from the Cache of the Firelord in {raid_mc:Molten Core}.
Bring the leaf to Vartrus the Ancient in Felwood and pick up 'Stave of the Ancients'.
Solo Artorius the Doombringer in Winterspring.
Solo Klinfran the Crazed in Burning Steppes.
Solo Solenor the Slayer in Silithus.
Solo Simone the Seductress in Un'Goro Crater.
Turn in the four demon heads to Vartrus for Lok'delar and the Ancient Rune Etched Stave.

Forever.note: The classic legendary. Both bindings are roughly a 3% drop each, so this is usually a long farm even with consistent weekly clears.
tips: Each half of the {item:18563:Bindings of the Windseeker} is a rare drop, roughly 3%, so plan on many weekly Molten Core clears.
You need one binding in hand to start 'Examine the Vessel'.
Forever.name: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker

steps.text: Raid {raid_mc:Molten Core} on a weekly reset schedule.
Loot the Bindings of the Windseeker (left) from Baron Geddon in Molten Core.
Loot the Bindings of the Windseeker (right) from Garr in Molten Core.
Start 'Examine the Vessel' with Highlord Demitrian in Silithus.
Loot the Essence of the Firelord from Ragnaros in Molten Core.
Turn in the bindings, the Essence and the materials to Demitrian ('Thunderaan the Windseeker').
Turn in 'Rise, Thunderfury!' to receive Thunderfury.

Reach Exalted with the Darkspear Trolls (optional for Trolls)
Train Journeyman Riding from your riding trainer
Save about 800-1,000 gold on that character
Buy a Swift Raptor from Zjolnir (Sen'jin Village, Durotar)
Level a Skyborne character to level 60
Train Journeyman Riding from your riding trainer
Save about 1,200 gold on that character
Buy a Swift Galestrider from Genn Fairweather (Zephras Isle)

tips: Your own race's mount needs no reputation. Another race's mount needs Exalted with that race's home city (Darkspear Trolls for the raptor, Ironforge for the ram).
Honored with the vendor's city gives a small discount.
Collecting them all on one character means Exalted with every city in your faction; the {rep_ambassador:Ambassador} goal covers that.
Each vendor sells a few colors of the same mount for the same price, and any of them counts.
Forever.name: Epic Racial Mounts

Forever.note: Two-handed legendary mace. You need the Eye of Sulfuras from Ragnaros and a Sulfuron Hammer crafted by a 300 Blacksmith (you or someone you trust). Combining them is instant, with no quest turn-in.
tips: The {item:17204:Eye of Sulfuras} is a rare drop from Ragnaros, roughly 3%.
'A Binding Contract' costs one {item:17203:Sulfuron Ingot} and needs no Thorium Brotherhood reputation. Lokhtos is in the Grim Guzzler.
Forever.name: Sulfuras, Hand of Ragnaros

steps.text: Raid {raid_mc:Molten Core} on a weekly reset schedule.
Loot the Eye of Sulfuras from Ragnaros in Molten Core.
Get the Plans: Sulfuron Hammer from Lokhtos Darkbargainer in Blackrock Depths ('A Binding Contract').
Collect 8 Sulfuron Ingots from Golemagg the Incinerator in Molten Core.
Smelt 20 Dark Iron Bars at the Black Forge in Blackrock Depths.
Gather 10 Blood of the Mountain (rare from Dark Iron deposits).
Gather 10 Lava Cores (Molten Core trash, BoE).
Gather 10 Fiery Cores (Molten Core trash, BoE).
Reach 300 Blacksmithing, or find a Blacksmith to craft it.
Combine the Sulfuron Hammer and the Eye of Sulfuras into Sulfuras.

Forever.name: Level Classes to 60
Forever.note: Tracked automatically. Every character you log into is remembered, and each class shows its highest character's level, filling as you earn XP. A class completes when any character of it hits 60. Characters you haven't logged into since installing show as not seen yet.
The furbolgs of Felwood and Winterspring. Rewards include safe passage through the Timbermaw tunnels and leatherworking patterns.
tips: Kill Deadwood furbolgs in Felwood and Winterfall furbolgs in Winterspring for reputation.
Turn in {item:21377:Deadwood Headdress Feathers} and {item:21383:Winterfall Spirit Beads} in batches of 5 at Timbermaw Hold.
Forever.name: Exalted: Timbermaw Hold

Forever.note: Lokhtos Darkbargainer's epic crafting recipes unlock as you climb, including fire resistance gear.
tips: Turn in {item:11370:Dark Iron Ore} and {item:18942:Fiery Flux} to Lokhtos Darkbargainer (Grim Guzzler, Blackrock Depths) early on.
From Honored on, turn in Molten Core materials such as {item:17011:Lava Cores} and {item:17010:Fiery Cores}.
Forever.name: Exalted: Thorium Brotherhood

Forever.note: Honored opens the Naxxramas attunement; Exalted unlocks the best Argent Dawn shoulder enchants.
tips: Wear an {item:12846:Argent Dawn Commission} while killing undead in the Plaguelands, Stratholme and Scholomance.
Turn in Scourgestones at Light's Hope Chapel or Chillwind Camp.
Forever.name: Exalted: Argent Dawn

Forever.note: The druids of Silithus. Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj kills and Twilight cultist turn-ins carry most of the grind.
tips: Do the Silithus quests at Cenarion Hold.
Turn in {item:20404:Encrypted Twilight Texts} and run Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj for steady reputation.
Forever.name: Exalted: Cenarion Circle

Forever.note: Earned in Zul'Gurub. Unlocks the class-specific Zandalar armor sets and head/leg enchants.
tips: Clear Zul'Gurub; every kill in the raid gives Zandalar reputation.
Turn in sets of ZG coins and bijous at Yojamba Isle.
Forever.name: Exalted: Zandalar Tribe

Forever.note: Needed to douse Molten Core's runes without Aqual Quintessence; Revered gives the Eternal Quintessence.
tips: Speak with Duke Hydraxis on his island east of Azshara and do his quest chain.
Kill Molten Core trash and bosses; each kill adds reputation.
Forever.name: Exalted: Hydraxian Waterlords

Forever.note: Starts at Hated. The rings from Anachronos upgrade as you climb, and the grind is famously long.
tips: Complete 'The Charge of the Dragonflights' line to obtain your Signet Ring.
Clear Temple of Ahn'Qiraj; kills and {item:21230:Ancient Qiraji Artifacts} raise reputation.
Forever.name: Exalted: Brood of Nozdormu

Forever.note: Exalted with all four Alliance capitals. Your own race's city is the easy one; the rest take turn-ins.
tips: Each city has repeatable cloth turn-ins at its cloth quartermaster, the fastest route for most players.
Forever.name: Ambassador: Alliance Capitals

Forever.note: Exalted with all four Horde capitals. Your own race's city is the easy one; the rest take turn-ins.
tips: Each city has repeatable cloth turn-ins at its cloth quartermaster, the fastest route for most players.

steps.text: Reach Exalted with the Darkspear Trolls.

Forever.name: Ambassador: Horde Capitals

Forever.note: Baron Rivendare's own steed. A tiny drop chance in the undead side of Stratholme.
tips: Baron Rivendare is on Stratholme's undead side, through the service entrance, which the {key_strat:Key to the City} opens.
Run it with a group, or solo once you're well geared. The drop chance is tiny, so expect many runs.

steps.text: Loot Deathcharger's Reins from Baron Rivendare.

Forever.name: Deathcharger's Reins

Forever.note: Rare drop from Bloodlord Mandokir in Zul'Gurub.
tips: Zul'Gurub is a 20-player raid, so you'll need a raid group.

steps.text: Loot the Swift Razzashi Raptor from Bloodlord Mandokir.

Forever.name: Swift Razzashi Raptor

Forever.note: Rare drop from High Priest Thekal in Zul'Gurub.
tips: Zul'Gurub is a 20-player raid, so you'll need a raid group.

steps.text: Loot the Swift Zulian Tiger from High Priest Thekal.

Forever.name: Swift Zulian Tiger

Forever.note: The black battle tank, originally awarded only to Scarab Lords who rang the gong at the opening of Ahn'Qiraj. Whether Forever offers it again depends on how its gate event runs.
tips: The gong can only be rung once your realm's Ahn'Qiraj war effort is finished. Forever may run its own version of the event.
steps: Complete the Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain.
Ring the Scarab Gong in Silithus to open Ahn'Qiraj.

steps.text: Own the Black Qiraji Resonating Crystal.

Forever.name: Black Qiraji Resonating Crystal

Forever.note: The Warlock's epic mount, earned through a level 60 quest chain that ends with a summoning ritual in Dire Maul. Quest IDs checked on Wowhead.
tips: Warlock only, and the chain needs level 60.
The chain starts with a demon trainer: Spackle Thornberry (Stormwind) or Jubahl Corpseseeker (Ironforge) for the Alliance, Martha Strain (Undercity) or Kurgul (Orgrimmar) for the Horde.
The Dire Maul ritual is a group fight, so bring friends.

steps.text: Complete 'Mor'zul Bloodbringer' from a demon trainer in a capital city.
Defeat the Xorothian Dreadsteed in Dire Maul ('Dreadsteed of Xoroth').

Forever.name: Dreadsteed (Warlock Epic Mount)

Forever.note: The Paladin's epic mount, earned through Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker's level 60 quest chain that ends in Scholomance. Quest IDs checked on Wowhead.
tips: Paladin only, and the chain needs level 60.
Several steps ask for materials and gold, so read each quest's requirements before heading out.

steps.text: Complete 'Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker' from Duthorian Rall in Stormwind City.
Complete 'Judgment and Redemption' in {key_scholo:Scholomance} to earn the Charger.

Forever.name: Charger (Paladin Epic Mount)

Forever.note: Tanking sword (Warrior and Paladin) forged in Onyxia's breath.

steps.text: Loot Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying in Dire Maul (rare).
Get the Unfired Ancient Blade from 'The Forging of Quel'Serrar' in the Dire Maul library.
Heat the blade in {raid_ony:Onyxia's} fire breath.
Drive the Heated Ancient Blade into Onyxia's corpse before it cools.
Return the Treated Ancient Blade to receive Quel'Serrar.

Forever.name: Quel'Serrar

Forever.note: Boss kills tick off automatically when you're in the raid with the addon loaded.

steps.text: Complete {att_mc:Attunement to the Core} in Blackrock Depths.

Forever.name: Clear Molten Core

Forever.note: Needs the Drakefire Amulet from the faction-specific attunement chain.

steps.text: Earn the Drakefire Amulet from the {att_ony:Onyxia attunement}.
Loot the Head of Onyxia and turn it in at your capital city.

Forever.name: Slay Onyxia

Forever.note: Boss kills tick off automatically when you're in the raid with the addon loaded.

steps.text: Complete {att_bwl:Blackhand's Command} ({key_ubrs:Upper Blackrock Spire}) for attunement.

Forever.name: Clear Blackwing Lair

Forever.note: The 20-player troll raid. Gahz'ranka and the Edge of Madness boss are optional.
Forever.name: Clear Zul'Gurub

Forever.note: The 20-player AQ raid in Silithus. Kills here also build Cenarion Circle reputation.
tips: Moam, Buru and Ayamiss are optional; the raid can go straight from Rajaxx to Ossirian.
Ossirian is only vulnerable near the crystals around his room. Move him from crystal to crystal.
Forever.name: Clear Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj

Forever.note: The 40-player AQ raid. The Bug Trio, Viscidus and Ouro are optional for reaching C'Thun.
Forever.name: Clear Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

Forever.note: The hardest raid in the game: all four wings, Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad.

steps.text: Get {att_naxx:attuned to Naxxramas} at Light's Hope Chapel.

Forever.name: Clear Naxxramas

Forever.note: A new 20-player raid in Mount Hyjal, opening December 9, 2026. More bosses join this guide as they're revealed.

steps.text: Defeat The Wild King in Hyjal Summit.

Forever.foreverNote: Its bosses, entrance and loot haven't been revealed yet; this guide grows as they are.
Forever.name: Clear Hyjal Summit

Forever.note: A new 10-player raid where the Night Elves hold dangerous prisoners, with three entrances, one in Mount Hyjal. Opens December 9, 2026.

steps.text: Defeat Sonya Darkhallow in the Barrow Deeps.

Forever.foreverNote: Its bosses, entrances and loot haven't been revealed yet; this guide grows as they are.
Forever.name: Clear the Barrow Deeps

Forever.note: Required to enter Molten Core. A short trip into Blackrock Depths to the raid's entry portal.

steps.text: Pick up 'Attunement to the Core' from Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain.
Recover a Core Fragment at the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths.
Return the Core Fragment to Lothos Riftwaker.

Forever.name: Attunement: Molten Core

Forever.note: The Alliance chain to the Drakefire Amulet, which opens Onyxia's Lair. It runs through Blackrock Spire and Blackrock Depths and ends with a masquerade in Stormwind.

steps.text: Complete 'Dragonkin Menace' from Helendis Riverhorn in the Burning Steppes.
Complete 'Drakefire Amulet' and receive the amulet.

Forever.name: Attunement: Onyxia's Lair (Alliance)

Forever.note: The Horde chain to the Drakefire Amulet, which opens Onyxia's Lair. It runs through Blackrock Spire, the Test of Skulls and Upper Blackrock Spire.

steps.text: Complete 'Warlord's Command' and turn it in to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath, Badlands.
Complete 'Blood of the Black Dragon Champion' and receive the Drakefire Amulet.

Forever.name: Attunement: Onyxia's Lair (Horde)

Forever.note: Without the Mark of Drakkisath you can't use the orb into Blackwing Lair. The whole quest happens in Blackrock Spire.

steps.text: Loot and read Blackhand's Command from the Scarshield Quartermaster in Blackrock Spire.
Defeat General Drakkisath in {key_ubrs:Upper Blackrock Spire}.
Touch Drakkisath's Brand behind him to gain the Mark of Drakkisath.

Forever.name: Attunement: Blackwing Lair

Forever.note: Taken at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands once you're Honored with the Argent Dawn.
tips: Reaching Revered first makes the attunement cheaper.

steps.text: Get attuned at Light's Hope Chapel.

Forever.name: Attunement: Naxxramas

Forever.note: The Seal of Ascension opens Upper Blackrock Spire. You build it from gems collected in Lower Blackrock Spire.
Forever.name: Key: Seal of Ascension (Upper Blackrock Spire)

Forever.note: The Skeleton Key opens Scholomance's front door.

steps.text: Complete 'The Key to Scholomance' and receive the Skeleton Key.

Forever.name: Key: Skeleton Key (Scholomance)

Forever.note: Opens the Shadowforge doors inside Blackrock Depths.

steps.text: Complete the second 'Dark Iron Legacy' and receive the Shadowforge Key.

Forever.name: Key: Shadowforge Key (Blackrock Depths)

Forever.note: Opens the locked gates in Stratholme.

steps.text: Loot the Key to the City from Magistrate Barthilas.

Forever.name: Key: Key to the City (Stratholme)

Forever.note: Opens the locked doors in Dire Maul's West and North wings.

steps.text: Loot the Crescent Key from Pusillin in Dire Maul East.

Forever.name: Key: Crescent Key (Dire Maul)

Forever.note: Fishing, Cooking and First Aid to 300 on any character. Pick the ones you want in the Library; each ticks itself from your skill levels.
Forever.name: Max Secondary Skills

Forever.note: Primary professions at 300 somewhere on your roster. Pick the ones you care about in the Library; each ticks itself from your skill levels.
Forever.name: Max Primary Professions

Forever.note: Hold your gold target on a single character, with milestones on the way. Ticks itself from your gold.
Forever.name: Save 5,000 Gold

Forever.note: Find your people: join a guild and wear its colors. Ticks itself.
tips: Guilds recruit in the Guild Recruitment channel in capital cities, and in general chat.
{item:5976:Guild Tabards} are sold by the Guild Master in each capital city once your guild has designed its tabard.

steps.text: Buy a Guild Tabard from a Guild Master in a capital city.

Forever.name: Join a Guild

Forever.note: Add the people you enjoy playing with to your friends list. Ticks itself.
tips: Right-click a player's name and choose Add Friend, or type /friend and their name.

steps.text: Have 5 friends on your friends list.
Have 10 friends on your friends list.
Have 25 friends on your friends list.

target.step: Have %s friends on your friends list.

Forever.name: Make Friends
